originality.rationale: The negative cohomology conclusion is already a direct implication of the two exact prior statements once the standard conjugacy theorem is applied. Wen proves that this very logarithmic-roof suspension has no local product structure and that every Hölder positive roof over the same full shift does have local product structure. Fisher--Hasselblatt Proposition 1.3.19 says positive cohomologous roofs generate conjugate special flows. Hence, if Wen's roof were continuously cohomologous to a Hölder roof, its suspension would be conjugate to a Hölder-roof suspension and would have local product structure, contradicting Wen. The submitted stable-drift proof is an alternate proof of that already implied corollary. The explicit rough roofs cohomologous to the constant roof are likewise a routine coboundary construction once Proposition 1.3.19 is available.
residual_risks: Older symbolic-cohomology literature may package the stable-drift criterion more generally, but further coverage is unnecessary because the inspected primary results already imply the negative claim.
